name: modernize-pro-data
description: A data migration tool for the Japanese financial sector, built for fully air-gapped target sites where assets move between HQ and field only by USB. It splits into a Coordinator (HQ) backend (Java 21 / Spring Boot 3 / Spring Batch, JPA, Flyway, Arrow, DuckDB) and a React + Vite + TypeScript frontend, communicating over REST and WebSocket. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
